Go-to-def on `[`/`]` for overloaded index operators.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- op.go --
package fork

type Vec struct {
	data []float64
}

func [](v *Vec, i int) float64 { //@loc(readDef, "func [](v *Vec, i int) float64")
	return v.data[i]
}

func []=(v *Vec, i int, x float64) { //@loc(writeDef, "func []=(v *Vec, i int, x float64)")
	v.data[i] = x
}

func use(v *Vec) {
	_ = v[0] //@loc(readUse, re"_ = v\\[0\\]")
	v[0] = 1 //@loc(writeUse, re"v\\[0\\] = 1")
}

//@def(readUse, readDef)
//@def(writeUse, writeDef)
